title: Ideal Capital advises on sale of Crown American Private School to OFG Education
summary: Dubai-based adviser supports shareholders in Ajman school deal as OFG Education pursues international expansion

Crown American Private School. Image Courtesy: Ideal Capital

Dubai-based adviser supports shareholders in Ajman school deal as OFG Education pursues international expansion

Press Release

Dubai, United Arab Emirates: Ideal Capital Management Consultants (“Ideal Capital”), a Dubai-based transaction advisory firm, acted as exclusive sell-side transaction adviser to the shareholders of Crown American Private School in connection with the school’s acquisition by OFG Education.

Based in Ajman, Crown American Private School follows an American K-12 curriculum. The acquisition forms part of OFG Education’s international expansion, as previously announced by the group.

Ideal Capital advised the school’s shareholders across the full transaction cycle, from sale readiness and buyer engagement through to completion, supporting them through the various stages of the transaction.

The transaction comes amid growth in Ajman’s private education sector. According to Ajman Statistics Center’s 2025 statistical book, private-school enrolment reached 88,437 students in the 2024–25 academic year, up from 74,673 in the previous year, highlighting the scale of the emirate’s private education market.

Ramesh Mahalingam, Managing Director of Ideal Capital, said, “The UAE’s education sector continues to attract interest from international operators looking to expand their presence in the region. For shareholders, transactions of this nature require careful consideration of the right strategic partner, the institution’s long-term direction and the objectives of the incoming owner. Our role is to guide shareholders through this process, bringing structure and clarity to complex decisions while helping them achieve an outcome aligned with their priorities.”

Education-sector transactions involve considerations beyond the transfer of ownership, including long-term institutional development, continuity for school communities and alignment between shareholders and prospective owners. Specialist transaction advisers play an important role in navigating the sale process while helping shareholders evaluate strategic options and work towards a successful outcome.

The terms of the transaction have not been disclosed.

About Ideal Capital

Ideal Capital Management Consultants is a Dubai-based transaction advisory, valuation and management consulting firm. It advises corporates, business owners, family offices and government entities across sectors including education, healthcare, manufacturing, food and beverage, and services.

Ideal Capital collaborates with Andersen Global in the UAE and is a member firm of CapFive, formerly the Alliance of International Corporate Advisors.

For more information, visit www.idealmc.com.
